title: Pink Halloween Party Decor
intro: Halloween does not have to be black and orange to count. Hot pink pumpkins, a pink and purple balloon garland, ghost print tablecloths, window clings and tall hot pink taper candles turn an ordinary table into the one people photograph before they eat. Spooky is optional. Cute is the point. Set it up in an afternoon, then keep the candles and pumpkins out through Thanksgiving, because pink pumpkins are a fall decision, not only a Halloween one.
